title: VertexAIProvider must forward passthrough, proxy and usage extraction to its Claude/MaaS delegate
answers: Anthropic passthrough on Vertex AI Claude returns 400
AI Gateway proxy for Claude on Vertex sent to generativelanguage googleapis
Vertex AI MaaS OpenAI passthrough not working in gateway
gateway proxy route goes to wrong host for Vertex model
body:
Symptom: POST /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages on a Vertex Claude endpoint returns 400, and /gateway/proxy/{endpoint}/v1/messages reaches generativelanguage.googleapis.com with a Vertex OAuth token.
Root cause: VertexAIProvider (mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py) only forwarded _chat, _chat_stream, _completions and get_endpoint_url, so _passthrough, _proxy and _extract_passthrough_token_usage fell through to the GeminiProvider base.
Fix pattern: forward _passthrough, _proxy and _extract_passthrough_token_usage to self._delegate when one exists, and to the Gemini implementation otherwise.
Constraints: the Claude delegate needs its own _passthrough. AnthropicProvider._passthrough posts to base_url + 'messages' with the model in the body, which Vertex rejects, so it must use _get_chat_path/_get_chat_stream_path and _prepare_payload (rawPredict/streamRawPredict, anthropic_version in body). Its _proxy returns 501 for any path other than v1/messages.
applies: Any new passthrough, proxy or usage hook added to VertexAIProvider or to a Vertex delegate.
says: Sending Anthropic messages through the gateway to Claude on Vertex AI returns a bad request
Gateway proxy requests for Claude models are routed to the wrong Google backend service
Passthrough requests to Models as a Service endpoints fail instead of reaching the provider
Track token usage properly when routing passthrough requests to Claude and other hosted models
Claude proxy route on the gateway rejects any path other than the messages endpoint
search: `VertexAIProvider` in `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py` must forward `_passthrough`, `_proxy`, and `_extract_passthrough_token_usage` to `self._delegate` when present, falling back to `GeminiProvider` base implementations otherwise. This prevents 400 errors on `POST /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages` and stops proxy requests from routing to `generativelanguage.googleapis.com` with a Vertex OAuth token. In `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIClaudeProvider`, `_passthrough` must use `_get_chat_path`/`_get_chat_stream_path` and `_prepare_payload` with `rawPredict`/`streamRawPredict` and `anthropic_version`, while `_proxy` returns 501 for any path other than `v1/messages`. Applies to any new passthrough, proxy, or usage hook added to `VertexAIProvider` or Vertex delegates.
